groups.label: Android app
items: Edit RAW files: RAF, DNG, CR2/CR3, NEF, ARW, ORF, RW2 and more
Supports newer cameras like X-T5, X-T50, X-H2, X-S20, X100VI and GFX 100 II
Better RAW exposure with no clipped highlights, and a RAW badge in the Studio
Import skips files that aren't photos

groups.label: Web version
items: Edit RAW files, the same way as the Android app
Camera info from RAW files is kept when you export
Works offline and can be installed like an app
